heading: Cleaner transfers, reliable shortcuts, and clearer settings
summary: The Transfers drawer stays out of the way, interrupted transfers survive a quit, ⌘P works with Korean input, and Preferences explain their options.
changes: Finished transfers move to a searchable History tab. The drawer lists only running, failed, and interrupted work and closes by itself when everything succeeds.
A transfer that was running when you quit is offered for retry at the next startup.
⌘P opens Snippets with Korean and other non-Latin input sources. ⌘⇧P is a second shortcut.
Authentication, Agents, Terminal, and About gain plain-language options, inline errors, and info buttons.
notice: Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon. Saved agent tokens remain local and are never written into skill files.
